title: TabaPay closes $155m financing; agrees to buy a bank
summary: Money movement platform TabaPay is set to buy a Denver-based bank after securing $155 million in strategic growth financing led by FTV Capital.
content: Money movement platform TabaPay has successfully closed $155 million in strategic growth financing. Following this major funding round led by FTV Capital, the company has also agreed to acquire a Denver-based bank to further expand its operations and strengthen its presence in the financial services sector.

title: Amazon shopping assistant now helps users check if a message is a scam
summary: Amazon has unveiled a new tool in the fight against fraudsters, enabling US customers to ask Alexa for Shopping to verify whether a message, email, phone call, or text actually came from the retail giant.
content: Amazon has introduced a new feature allowing US customers to use its Alexa shopping assistant to verify if messages, emails, phone calls, or texts genuinely originated from the retail giant. This tool aims to help consumers combat fraudsters and protect themselves against deceptive communications by providing a quick way to authenticate suspicious outreach claiming to be from Amazon.

title: How stablecoins are quietly becoming the Fed’s debt buyer of last resort
summary:
Dollar tokens can expand private use and Treasury-bill demand without deciding how central banks allocate reserves.
The post How stablecoins are quietly becoming the Fed’s debt buyer of last resort appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Dollar-pegged stablecoins are increasingly acting as a private sector buyer for government debt. By expanding the demand for Treasury bills, these tokens play a unique role in supporting federal debt markets without requiring direct central bank allocation of reserves.

title: Nearly $10 million must escape a dying Ethereum L2 network before New Year’s Eve or risk becoming unrecoverable
summary:
The Ethereum layer 2 stopped deposits and warned that exit routes differ before its network and explorer shut down.
The post Nearly $10 million must escape a dying Ethereum L2 network before New Year’s Eve or risk becoming unrecoverable appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: An Ethereum layer 2 network has issued a critical warning for users to withdraw nearly $10 million in funds before New Year’s Eve. The network has already halted deposits and cautioned that exit routes vary. If users fail to move their assets before the impending shutdown of the network and its explorer, the funds risk becoming permanently unrecoverable.
